item.title: NetBird Self-Hosted: Mesh VPN Without Port Forwarding
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: NetBird turns your devices into one private mesh network and, more recently, doubles as a reverse proxy - so home services go public without a single open port on the router.
